title: Trust in Depth: Giving agents more autonomy without losing control
summary: Enterprise leaders want AI agents to take on more work but don't fully trust them to act correctly every time. Trust in Depth is AWS's layered approach-scope, know, bound, observe, and prove-that lets agents act on their own when their actions can be verified, reserving human jud
reason: AWS blog describes a conceptual 'Trust in Depth' approach for agent autonomy; it announces no named model release (1-1), research artifact (2-1), business event (3-1), policy action (4-1), or open-source tool/framework release (5-1). No rule covers this.
